title: Check
description: A single automated check that verifies a spec's acceptance criteria.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the contents of each in-scope file.

negate.description: Inverts the check. When false (default), a match is a violation (forbidden). When true, a file with no match is a violation (required).

pattern.description: Path glob matched against the paths of in-scope files.

negate.description: Inverts the check. When false (default), a matching path is a violation (forbidden). When true, the absence of any matching path is a violation (required).

oneOf.title: script check
oneOf.description: Runs an external script stored at `scripts/<spec-id>/<script>`, resolved under its base directory (the spex directory for tech-spec and inherited checks, the repository directory for per-repo `checks_additional` and for `checks_override` that set `script`).

script.description: Script filename (for example `llm-writing.sh`). Resolved at `scripts/<spec-id>/<script>` under the base directory, so the `<spec-id>` folder keeps checks from different specs from sharing a path.

run.description: Invocation granularity. `per-file` runs the script with the matched files (after include/exclude) as arguments; `per-repo` runs it once in the repository directory with no file arguments. Defaults to `per-file`.

spec.description: Tech spec ID this check belongs to. Used only by per-repo checks in spex.yml, where the check's identity is `<spec>/<name>`; omitted inside tech-spec files, which supply the spec ID themselves.

description.description: Optional human-readable summary of what the check verifies.

type.description: How the check is executed: regexp matches file contents, glob matches file paths, script runs an external program.

severity.description: Severity when the check fails. Defaults to error when omitted.

include.description: Glob patterns that narrow this check's file set to matching paths. When omitted, all non-ignored files are in scope.

exclude.description: Glob patterns that remove matching paths from this check's file set.
